raw_text: FACT CHECK: A viral post claiming India has deployed robot soldiers along the Line of Control is SATIRE from the Fauji Times parody account. The original article, published on April 1st, includes a clear disclaimer identifying it as humor. No such deployment has occurred. The Indian Army has not issued any statement about robot soldiers. This is an April Fools Day joke being shared without context.
clean_text: Fact Check India confirms viral robot soldier post is April Fools satire from Fauji Times parody. No such deployment occurred. Indian Army issued no such statement.
